source: The default scene (852 nm tweezer along x, B = 3 G along z) with a D2 sigma+ cycling probe on F = 2 -> F' = 3 at 0.3 mW/cm2, +28 MHz, and a D2 beam 3 GHz above F = 2 -> F' = 3 at 3e4 mW/cm2 along +y (Rabi ~575 MHz), 10 us and 11 samples on the CPU, as the app sends it: the validation of v2026.11.3.2 (claude/validate-3d, repro/F10_far_D2_3GHz_probe28MHz.json, finding F10). Every drive folded, the folded probe/strong-beam Raman pairs' van Vleck paths add a decay no jump carries, below zero (-3.2 rad/us at the focus): the trajectories' norm grows and the released solve ran away.
